t: There's no bridge here. This stretch of the Thames, between Waterloo Bridge and Blackfriars Bridge, is where the Garden Bridge was meant to go. It was a private proposal for a pedestrian-only crossing, covered in planting, with no cycles or vehicles. Joanna Lumley first had the idea, and Boris Johnson, then Mayor, strongly backed it. Thomas Heatherwick, the designer, worked on it with Arup. It was never built, and the project is remembered as an unsuccessful one.
